capabilities: Sync Doubao conversations into Markdown notes
Update notes by uid after rename or move
disambiguation: Not a media importer; it leaves image and file URLs in the note and does not download media yet.
extras: UI currently uses Simplified Chinese. Doubao web endpoints are private and may change; sync stops with a visible error if the API format changes. Automatic sync requests up to 200 recent conversations per run, and a 200-item list does not prove full account coverage. Conversations over 1000 message pages or with a repeated page are skipped. Media is not downloaded.
intentEvidence: Doubao Sync is a sister plugin to Dedao Brain Sync.
problem: Doubao conversations live only on the web, so they cannot be searched, linked, or kept as local notes in the vault.

relations.evidence: Settings components and interaction patterns adapted from Dedao Brain Sync retain the original MIT attribution.

summary: Plugin that saves Doubao conversations as local Markdown notes with time-range sync, scheduling, and 30-day history.
